title: Dead Sea Scrolls Isaiah matches text a thousand years later
summary: Joe Rogan tells of Dead Sea Scrolls Isaiah matches text a thousand years later, about ancient at Qumran, Dead Sea, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Wes Huff when he was on my podcast explained to me that the book of Isaiah that they found in the Dead Sea Scrolls is verbatim the same as the book of Isaiah that was a thousand years more recent.

plain: A podcast host, Joe Rogan, says that one of his guests, Wes Huff, told him about the Dead Sea Scrolls, ancient manuscripts found at Qumran near the Dead Sea. According to Rogan, Huff explained that the Book of Isaiah, part of the Bible, found among the scrolls is word for word the same as a copy made a thousand years later. Rogan tells it to show how faithfully old texts could be handed down across the centuries.
